definitions.rise: body z relative to its actual post-settling t0; not proof of grasp
definitions.distance: EEF point to body origin; not contact or fingertip distance
definitions.missing: contact, object orientation, articulated drawer/door joint positions absent from NPZ
definitions.clock: sample0 post settling; sample s after action s-1; actual 7D actions
definitions.positive_gripper: actual action[-1] > 0 requests closure; negative requests opening; not contact
definitions.first_close: action array index c applies between observed samples c and c+1; nearest-body is only geometry
definitions.rise_stage: 3cm is descriptive boundary; 5cm and distance12cm separate visibly displaced nearby bodies
definitions.uncertainty: exact discrete whole-task bootstrap; resample 8 or 36 observed task totals equally, no seed uncertainty
definitions.In_predicate: installed LIBERO In = container check_contact(object) AND check_contain(object); no released-gripper requirement

task16_distribution.limitation: nearest body at first closure is not by itself intention/contact; 50 unchanged target traces and subsequent non-target transport establish the observable selection failure

visual_read_only_case.observation: Both original base-camera sequences show the top drawer extended by step295 while the goal bowl remains on the table; most preceding sampled frames remain at the cabinet handle. One failed example only; no all-50 drawer-state estimate.

science_boundaries: Single preregistered450 endpoint, full-only training. Interpreter, conditional A, parameterization and objective history differ jointly; no isolated causal estimate for S.
Task16 non-target transport coexists with task31 butter lifting and support96 butter-to-tray success; global inability to move butter or use the gripper is inconsistent with these records.
Task31 Context gains are real two-goal successes but MT comparison is six gains/six losses; broad compositional repair is not established.
Seen target24 remains45/96 and support12 is46/48; overall91/144 does not show uniformly strong acquisition before held transfer.
No contacts, object orientations or drawer joint positions in NPZ; lift/proximity thresholds are descriptive, not grasp truth. In success does not establish release or post-success stability.
No new model forward, GPU, environment replay, label consumption for learning, checkpoint selection, controls, or neuron/module causal inference.

mechanism.scope: CPU readback only; no new PI05 forward, gradients, environment or GPU. Native operator effects use beta teacher X, not actual rollout hidden. FM is one sampled tau, not ten-step actions.

selected_head_algebra.scope: CPU linear/GELU algebra at eight existing train native captures and three registered sites; feature magnitude and local readout sensitivity do not establish semantic failure or causal closed-loop effect. No PI05/native/rollout forward, gradients or update.

historical_comparison.scope: Bounded A/B historical comparison only. CPU reads of existing rows, registered contracts, Git source and stored prediction tensors. No model/env/optimizer/GPU, no Test or temporal-control raw reads, no tracked writes.
historical_comparison.A_seen_limit: No full seen endpoints for T450/T900/T2340 or Context450 were supplied by the bounded historical readouts; do not infer a same-graph 450-to-900 full-seen trend. The seen diagnostics use 4 init states per task, not held400.
historical_comparison.A_A28_method: CPU float64 mean squared prediction-target difference on saved 28x50x7 tensors, first5 and full50. Four fixed train tasks 0/12/20/32, two teachers each; public averaged once per task, full averaged over 8 conditions. Not a held/rollout proxy.

A_exposure.shared: Same 36 tasks, 4 tasks x 28 queries per update, cross-episode main full50x7 FM, fixed source1000/normalization, own query dualRGB/state, fixed probe1729/tau1 state-free teacher native.
A_exposure.objective: T and current new conditional graph: full FM only, coefficient1. Context/Joint/self_read: full FM plus public beta FM on identical queries/noise/time, coefficients1 each. Public supervision is not teacher-native supervision.
A_exposure.clock: AdamW lr3e-4, warmup150, decay1200, floor1e-5, absolute scheduler and optimizer resumed; new graph must be fresh. T1890 parent was full-only control, not public_aux.

A_cost.limits: Batch scopes differ: T old continuation included two arms or five held panels, Context one arm plus public144/A28. Do not compare totals as a pure runtime benchmark.

historical_comparison.B_distinction: same-video loss supervises final generated LoRA through normal query with own state; public query FM supervises shared 76 factors on cross-episode own-state random-time inputs; LocalField/NativeCorrection use teacher action to create frozen bare-source output/weight correction labels consumed by learned Writer, not to train shared beta-native output; section91 proposes shared beta-native fixed endpoint direct action supervision but no implementation/run exists in the bounded sources.
